purpose: Implement the universal pre-claim current-usability evidence gate: selected outbound execution identity must be freshly verified, entitled and permitted in the exact environment before OperationJournal may issue its one execution claim.

lineage.outcome: An exact approved/connected operation still cannot claim execution if its selected route capability is stale, unverified, revoked, unentitled, unpermitted or for a different environment/subject/capability.
lineage.capability: Fresh entitlement, permission and capability evidence gate

completion_proof: fresh verified evidence with matching job/route/subject/capability/environment and explicit GRANTED or NOT_REQUIRED access returns ALLOW
unverified, denied/unknown entitlement, denied/unknown permission or wrong identity dimensions return DENY
expired evidence or changed environment returns STALE
DENY dominates STALE while preserving all reason codes
NOT_REQUIRED must be explicit and is never inferred
verified and age fields use strict bool/integer validation
eligibility decision never grants action authority and exposes no execution/network/credential verb
outbound operation identity binds route + eligibility subject + capability and idempotency includes all three
outbound claim requires exact transport ALLOW plus exact eligibility ALLOW; missing/stale/wrong-subject/wrong-route decisions fail before claim
operation schema v1 migrates additively to v2; legacy outbound prepared operations without eligibility identity remain preserved but fail closed for execution
next_selection_rule: After CORE-04E evidence, reconcile and globally compare host multi-step transaction/compensation, provider connection/revoke/scopes, secure credential boundary, team permissions and preserved CORE-02 Success Memory. Do not extend eligibility by adjacency.
